title: Geologic map of California, Ukiah sheet
authors: C. W. Jennings and R. G. Strand

Kl.name: Lower Cretaceous marine rocks
Kl.description: Sandstone, shale and conglomerate of the source’s Shasta series, including Horsetown and Paskenta formations. The regional unit also includes detrital serpentine in the Wilbur Springs area.

Ku.name: Upper Cretaceous marine rocks
Ku.description: Marine sedimentary rocks, broadly grouped by age: sandstone, siltstone, shale and conglomerate. Individual beds and formations are not resolved by this regional layer.

Qal.name: Recent alluvium
Qal.description: Unconsolidated valley fill, including sand, conglomerate and breccia. The source groups these deposits as Recent Alluvium.

processing: Source vectors clipped to a 2 km context margin around the terrain; transformed from supplied NAD83 / California Albers to WGS84. No simplification, snapping, inferred contacts or field-scale subdivision. Colors are atlas display colors. Source age terminology retained alongside readable age labels.
limitations: Regional context at 1:250,000. Contacts are generalized, not surveyed well or hillslope boundaries. This layer does not show weathering depth, groundwater, rock thickness or current fault activity.
